evals.expected_output: Runs plans.py validate, reports the duplicated id with both paths, and proposes renumbering the newer folder with the next free id (updating references to it), asking before renaming.
expectations: Identifies the duplicated id and both folders
Uses next-id to propose a new id rather than inventing one
Asks before renaming a folder that may already be referenced
